name: Veterinary Clinic / Animal Hospital
description: Small animal or mixed-animal veterinary practice providing wellness care, medical treatment, surgery, dentistry, and emergency services for companion animals and/or livestock. Suitable for solo vet practices, multi-vet animal hospitals, and corporate-owned veterinary chains.

org_structure.overview: The veterinary clinic is organized around the medical team (veterinarians, vet technicians, assistants) providing compassionate care for animals, with strong front-office and client-relations support. The practice manager oversees business operations while the medical director or lead veterinarian sets clinical standards. The model typically includes exam-room consultations, in-house laboratory, digital radiography, surgical suite, pharmacy/dispensary, and hospitalization/kennel areas. Revenue comes from exam fees, procedures, diagnostics, pharmacy, and retail (pet food, preventatives). Scheduling must accommodate both appointments and same-day urgent visits.

departments.name: Practice Leadership
departments.description: Veterinary leadership and practice management setting medical standards and business direction.

roles.title: Medical Director / Lead Veterinarian
roles.description: Medical quality, protocol development, peer review, complex case consultation, and veterinary team mentorship.

roles.title: Practice Manager
roles.description: Business operations: staffing, scheduling, P&L, inventory, payroll, facility management, and client experience.

departments.name: Veterinary Medical Team
departments.description: Licensed veterinarians providing medical and surgical care for animal patients.

roles.title: Associate Veterinarian (DVM / VMD)
roles.description: Wellness exams, vaccination, diagnosis and treatment of medical conditions, surgery (spay/neuter, soft tissue, orthopedics), dentistry, and client education.

roles.title: Veterinary Specialist (Internal Medicine, Surgery, etc.)
roles.description: Board-certified specialist handling advanced medical and surgical cases; typically at larger referral hospitals or specialty practices.

departments.name: Veterinary Technicians & Nursing
departments.description: Credentialed veterinary technicians and assistants supporting veterinarians in patient care, procedures, and hospitalization.

roles.title: Registered / Licensed Veterinary Technician (RVT/LVT)
roles.description: Medical procedures: IV catheter placement, blood draw, anesthesia monitoring, radiography, lab testing, dental scaling, and hospitalized patient care.

roles.title: Veterinary Assistant
roles.description: Restraint, exam room preparation, lab sample collection, surgical prep, instrument sterilization, and kennel care support.

roles.title: Kennel Technician / Hospital Care Attendant
roles.description: Animal housing care: feeding, walking, cleaning kennels/runs, administering medications as directed, and monitoring hospitalized patients.

departments.name: Diagnostic & Support Services
departments.description: In-house laboratory, imaging, pharmacy, and surgical support functions.

roles.title: Veterinary Lab Technician
roles.description: In-house lab testing (blood chemistry, hematology, urinalysis, fecal, cytology, microbiology) and reference lab coordination (IDEXX, Antech).

roles.title: Veterinary Pharmacy / Dispensary Coordinator
roles.description: Pharmacy inventory management, prescription dispensing, controlled substance logs, and client medication instructions.

departments.name: Front Office & Client Relations
departments.description: Client-facing and administrative roles managing scheduling, communication, financial transactions, and client education.

roles.title: Client Service Representative (CSR) / Receptionist
roles.description: Phone management, appointment scheduling, client check-in/out, payment processing, and client communication (reminders, follow-ups).

roles.title: Treatment Plan / Financial Coordinator
roles.description: Presents treatment estimates to clients, discusses financial options (CareCredit, insurance claims), and manages payment plans.

roles.title: Inventory / Retail Coordinator
roles.description: Manages retail inventory (prescription diets, preventatives, pet supplies), vendor ordering, and retail merchandising.

roles.title: Medical Records / Data Entry Clerk
roles.description: Maintains paper and electronic medical records, scans records, manages lab results filing, and supports documentation compliance.

key_relationships: Medical Director and Practice Manager are the dual leadership of the clinic — medical quality and business performance are equally important and interdependent.
Associate Veterinarians and Veterinary Technicians work in exam-room teams — efficient tech support directly increases exam throughput and client satisfaction.
Veterinary Assistant and Kennel Tech support the entire medical team; they are the eyes-on for hospitalized patients and report changes in condition to the veterinarian.
Client Service Representatives (CSRs) are the first and last point of client contact; they coordinate closely with the medical team on appointment flow and wait-time management.
Lab Technician provides results that drive real-time medical decision-making; quick in-house lab turnaround enables same-visit diagnosis and treatment.
Treatment Plan Coordinator bridges the veterinarian's recommended care plan with the client's financial situation — case acceptance often depends on this role's communication skills.
Pharmacy/Retail Coordinator and Inventory Coordinator ensure that prescribed medications, prescription diets, and preventatives are in stock when needed.
